card.name: Keep OUT of reach, and unit word endings
card.fires_on: The word "out" in the warning "Keep out of reach of children", and the final part of split unit words such as micrograms, units, milliunits and mcg after a number.

modes.label: Keep out of reach
modes.description: The word out in the child-safety warning, usually in capitals after KEEP.
modes.example: WARNINGS: KEEP<< OUT>> OF REACH OF CHILDREN.

modes.label: Ends of unit words
modes.description: The last piece of a dose unit written in parts, right after a number.
modes.example: Administer 60-un<<its>>/kg bolus initially in patients not treated

modes.label: Split word out
modes.description: The out piece inside a hyphenated word like socket-outlets.
modes.example: provide enough socket<<-out>>lets - never overloading socket or outlets
